definitions.explanation: To move in a forward direction physically.
For work, a situation, or a process to move forward or make progress.
For a clock or watch to run fast.

examples.japanese: {前|まえ}に{進|すす}んでください。
{仕事|しごと}が{順調|じゅんちょう}に{進|すす}んでいる。
この{時計|とけい}は5{分|ふん}{進|すす}んでいる。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {進|すす}める (transitive, to advance something). Pattern: Xが{進|すす}む (X advances).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state or result. {進|すす}んでいる = 'is advancing' or 'has advanced.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{前|まえ}に{進|すす}む (move forward)
・{仕事|しごと}が{進|すす}む (work progresses)
・{道|みち}を{進|すす}む (proceed along a road)
・{進|すす}んで (willingly, voluntarily)
・{時計|とけい}が{進|すす}む (clock is fast)

CONTRAST:
・{進|すす}む (intransitive): X advances
・{進|すす}める (transitive): (someone) advances X

OPPOSITE:
・{遅|おく}れる (to fall behind, be late)
・{戻|もど}る (to go back)
